description: This file defines classes implementing the IFileStorage interface for different storage backends, including IndexedDB, Cache Storage, and Origin Private File System, with methods for managing file metadata and chunks.

classes.name: IndexedDBFileStore
classes.description: Implements file storage using IndexedDB, supporting metadata and chunk operations.

classes.name: CacheStorageFileStore
classes.description: Implements file storage using Cache Storage API, supporting metadata and chunk operations.

classes.name: OriginPrivateFileSystem
classes.description: Implements file storage using Origin Private File System via web worker, supporting metadata and chunk operations.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all stored data and metadata.

methods.name: listChunks
methods.description: Lists chunks with a specific prefix.
